verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents dedicated bulk search, where you paste a list, pick TLDs, and add all available names to the cart in one click, which covers bulk registration. It also documents bulk transfer of domains "all at once", plus an API pitched for "large bulk adjustments" covering registering, transferring, and renewing via commands. Smart folders offer folder-wide domain adjustments. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk renewal UI, explicitly documented bulk nameserver changes (only implied via folder-wide adjustments and the API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bulk tools.
